detail.longDescription:
KeeperDB 3.0.1 and 3.1.0 introduce new features, including:

- The KeeperDB MCP Server lets AI agents explore databases in read-only mode without exposing passwords, and can continue working while KeeperDB is locked (if enabled)  
- KeeperAI integrates with preferred AI provider and requests authorization before data-modifying operations 
- Database sessions will not be terminated when computer is put to sleep, and sleep duration is excluded from calculations for session and MCP idle timeouts
- MongoDB queries can be written in mongosh syntax
- Save connections from the New Tab form
